name: Camping Checklist
description: A complete tent camping checklist covering shelter, sleep system, cooking gear, clothing, tools and safety essentials.

items.text: Tent with poles, stakes, and guy lines
Repair tape or a patch kit
items.note: Pitch and inspect your tent at home before the trip.

items.text: Doormat or small tarp for the entrance
Sleeping bag rated for the expected low temperature
Pillow or stuff sack to use as one
Pump if your mattress needs one
Plates, bowls, cups, and reusable cutlery
Biodegradable soap, sponge, and a wash basin
Trash bags and sealed containers for food storage
Insulating layer like a fleece or down jacket
Sturdy shoes or hiking boots and camp sandals
Warm hat, gloves, and extra socks
Sleepwear set aside just for the tent
Drinking water (about one gallon per person per day)
Water filter or purification tablets as backup
Toilet paper and a trowel for cat holes
Fully charged phone and a power bank
Check the weather and conditions and share your plan
items.note: Tell someone your route and expected return time.

faq.q: What do I need for tent camping?
faq.a: You need a tent with stakes, a sleeping bag and pad, a camp kitchen for cooking, weather-appropriate clothing, lighting, and a first-aid kit. Pack water and food, plus tools like a knife and headlamp, and tailor the list to your campsite's facilities.

faq.q: How should I prepare for a camping trip?
faq.a: Check the weather forecast and trail or park conditions, confirm your reservation, and test your gear before you go. Pack by category, bring enough water, and tell someone your trip plan and expected return time for safety.

faq.q: What should I sleep on while camping?
faq.a: Use a sleeping pad or air mattress under a sleeping bag rated for the expected low temperature. A pad insulates you from the cold ground, which matters as much as the bag's rating for staying warm overnight.

faq.q: Can I print this camping checklist?
faq.a: Yes. You can print the checklist or download it as a PDF, then tick off each item as you pack and again when you break down camp.

faq.q: How do I stay safe while camping?
faq.a: Check the weather and conditions before you go, tell someone your plans and return time, and store food sealed and away from your tent to deter wildlife. Carry a first-aid kit, a light, and a way to call for help.
